remarks: NEWLY/FULLY RENOVATED 1ST FLOOR UNIT features fresh paint, new laminate wood flooring and a versatile floor plan. The living room is open to the tiled kitchen with brand new cabinets, countertops and stainless-steel appliances. There are 2 bedrooms and an additional room which can be used as a 3rd bedroom, home office or even a dining room. The large double closet outside of the full bath is perfect as a dressing room space (7x8) and/or additional storage. 2 off-street parking spaces and a shared grill/patio space as well. Don't miss this ready-to-go unit, located in a convenient area, right off Rt 7 with quick access to multiple local highways, SONO, Metro North and walking distance to many local shops and restaurants.
